title: Slow-Roasted Chicken Buried in Gingery Brown Rice

source.text: Joshua McFadden, Grains for Every Season (2021)

origin: Buried Chicken Google Doc (2026-05-16), adapted from the cookbook

steps.action: Soak 2 to 24 hr (refrigerate if longer than 2 hr):
items: 2 cups long-grain brown rice (400 g), covered by 2 in cool water

steps.text: Drain well, tapping the sieve to shake it dry.

steps.action: Sauté in a large skillet over medium, without browning:
Stir 1 min until coated, then take off the heat:

items: 1 whole chicken, 3 to 4 lb (1.3 to 1.8 kg)
Kosher salt and black pepper to taste

steps.action: Assemble in a Dutch oven that fits the chicken snugly:
items: Rice mixture, a ½ in layer on the bottom
Chicken on top; pack the rest of the rice around the sides
Wipe stray grains off the skin

steps.action: Pour in, cover, and roast 1 hr:
Uncover, butter the chicken, and roast 30 to 45 min more, until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender:
items: 2 Tbsp unsalted butter, over the breast and exposed skin

items.text: Breast at least 165 °F (74 °C), thigh at least 175 °F (80 °C)
sub: It will be very done and falling off the bone

steps.text: Optional: broil a few min, until the skin darkens and the top rice crisps; watch closely.
Rest 10 min; pull apart in the pot or carve on a board.
